    ​​Inspiring better lives​

    We are a global health and wellness community born to support you in living your best life. For over 40 years and in more than 90 countries, we’ve empowered millions of people to make real changes to their lives with our science-backed products, the support of a coach – what we call an Herbalife Independent Distributor – and the opportunity to build a business. And we’re just getting started.

     

    To us, the best lives are balanced lives. Through our Herbalife Independent Distributors, who foster community, personal growth and business opportunities to help you thrive, we offer a wide range of products designed to help you meet your needs and reach your goals. You bring the will to get started, and we’ll help you every step of the way.

     

    Let’s do this!

    Supporting wellness journeys for over 45 years

    Since 1980, we have helped people achieve their health goals. What began as a simple way to lose weight has grown into nutrition, fitness and wellness. We know each journey is unique, and we’re proud to empower people every step of the way.

    It starts with science

    Over 200 scientists, experts and PhDs work in state-of-the art facilities to ensure that our science-backed products deliver results. They’re made with high-quality ingredients and go through a comprehensive quality assurance program that guarantees that what’s on the label is in the product.

    Energize like a pro

    From Cristiano Ronaldo and the LA Galaxy to Olympians, athletes from around the world trust our sports nutrition products to meet their demanding training needs and deliver when they need it most.

    Innovation leads the way

    With new products to serve evolving wellness journeys, environmentally friendly solutions and cutting-edge AI, we are helping Distributors make a bigger impact in more customers’ lives than ever before.

    Build it better, together

    When we support each other, anything is possible. Our global community, engaged coaches and inspiring leaders empower people on their journey to wellness. For 45 years and beyond, we are here to help people live their best lives.

    Total well-being

    ​​Achieving total well-being is a journey that thrives on the balance of our bodies, minds and futures. This empowers us to look and feel our best.​

    ​​Physical health
    Reach your body’s potential with the help of our products and fitness and nutrition programs that your Herbalife Independent Distributor will tailor to your needs following Herbalife guidance. From shakes and bars to supplements and skin care, our products are trusted by our consumers and make chasing goals taste great.

    ​Emotional well-being
    Get better results with a Herbalife Independent Distributor by your side. Herbalife Independent Distributors will motivate you, inspire you and hold you accountable. With that kind of support, you’ll be able to keep your momentum alive and keep moving forward.

    ​Financial opportunity
    Build a business for yourself, but never by yourself. As an Herbalife Independent Distributor, you’ll have the opportunity to pursue earning opportunities while helping others transform into better versions of themselves.

    Our personal approach

    Our science-backed nutrition products are offered exclusively through our network of Herbalife Independent Distributors. As global ambassadors of our brand, these dedicated entrepreneurs support their customers through a passion for health and nutrition and by sharing their own wellness journeys. Herbalife’s team of experts supports our Herbalife Independent Distributors with programs, product guidance and other informational materials to help their customers. Herbalife Independent Distributors also have a supportive community of fellow Distributors to help them reach their customers.

    Herbalife Independent Distributors give their customers personal encouragement that goes beyond recommending effective products. They tailor the relationship to their customers’ unique needs so they feel seen, heard and valued. This includes motivating and coaching their customers to help them set big goals and stay on track.

    Herbalife Independent Distributors help you maintain the momentum you need to keep achieving your goals - we call that the Distributor Difference.

    360° focus on health and wellness

    The Herbalife Nutrition Philosophy is our core belief that with balanced nutrition, a healthy and active lifestyle, and a personalized plan, you can live your best life. That means a combination of nourishing foods, healthy hydration, targeted nutritional supplements and regular exercise. With our balanced approach, you’ll feel more energized and motivated.

    We believe that your best life extends beyond nutrition alone. That means a life with exercise and movement while also getting quality sleep, proper hydration and rejuvenating rest. Together, we’ll empower you to achieve your health and wellness goals while discovering your full potential along the way.

    Immerse yourself in Herbalife Innovation and Manufacturing (HIM)–Winston-Salem

    Sprawling over 100 acres, the 800,000-square-foot HIM facility in Winston-Salem is an achievement in efficiency, safety and production. Equipped with advanced technology, like electron microscopes, product development labs, and automated packaging and distribution lines, HIMWS is built to deliver thousands of the best Herbalife® products around the world. Take the virtual tour to discover how Herbalife builds and maintains its commitment to quality.

    Explore Now

    Innovation

    Herbalife operates five innovation and manufacturing facilities worldwide. A central aspect of our innovation approach revolves around personalization, and we work closely with our Herbalife Independent Distributors, who possess valuable insights into customer preferences and needs.

    ​We also foster partnerships with forward-thinking companies that share our commitment to developing effective products with the latest innovations. In 2018, we introduced the Greenhouse initiative, empowering our employees to contribute innovative ideas to better the company.

    ​By embracing innovation, we remain dedicated to empowering people to live their best lives.​

    When you become a Distributor, you’ll join an established team and be mentored by someone who knows the ropes. They’ll work with you to start and grow your business.

    Already connected?

    If you've shopped with us before or created an account, we can help you find your Distributor. Enter your email below and select Search to get started.

    If you haven't made a purchase but know a Distributor, find them by entering their name, business name, website or postal code in the section farther below and selecting Search.

    If you're new to Herbalife or don't know a Distributor, you can connect with one by selecting Connect me.
